biotools.summary: This package implements a variety of methods for batch correction in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data. It incorporates quantitative metrics (e.g. Wasserstein distance, Adjusted Rand Index) to evaluate their performance. Furthermore, the package assists users in identifying and applying the optimal method for specific datasets.
biotools.name: BatChef
